purpose: Calibrate naturally confusable author pairs and hard negatives before interpreting aligned rewrite degradation.

owner_supplied_neighbor_hypotheses.author: Stian Gudmundsen Høiland
owner_supplied_neighbor_hypotheses.owner_reason: Joel reports that Stian naturally writes/thinks somewhat like him and that this affinity is part of why they clicked.

non_invention_rule: Do not create an operational author-neighborhood metric or universal decision threshold while standard score vectors, pairwise confusions, margins, resampling stability, and verification-style evidence remain sufficient.
diagnostics: pairwise author-profile cosine matrix when frozen profile scores are available
true-author margin against the highest-scoring alternative
easy-negative and hard-negative ranking from natural originals
aligned rewrite score deltas against every author
whether the winning rewrite alternative was already a natural-original hard negative
separate counts for reliable and naturally ambiguous originals

reliability_boundary.rule: The analyzer never invents a reliability threshold. Upstream evaluation must assign original_reliability_status from a predeclared held-out/resampling rule. Only originals marked eligible may count toward rewrite-degradation or IER interpretation.

interpretation_guardrails: A nearest-author flip is not automatically idiolect erasure.
A rise in similarity to Joel is not sufficient evidence of unique Joel identifiability.
A declared neighbor is retained as a hard negative rather than removed to improve accuracy.
Owner-reported affinity motivates the near-neighbor hypothesis but does not prove the cause or magnitude of similarity.
Shared-thread versus non-overlap comparisons can characterize context dependence but cannot by themselves separate homophily from accommodation.
No result authorizes changing owner-final prose or lowering semantic/editorial fidelity requirements.
No IER, Tier-A threshold, or validated-for-register claim is authorized until original attribution is reliably above chance under the registered condition.

cost_boundary.first_choice: reuse existing synchronized metadata, score vectors, and frozen artifacts
cost_boundary.new_heavy_run: only after documenting a specific missing-data field that cannot be recovered from existing evidence
cost_boundary.github_actions_note: Batch any necessary heavy embedding work after the register-corpus authority is resolved; do not spend private Actions minutes on redundant recomputation.
